note: an explicit localBoundIP of 0.0.0.0 is still dual-stack on the oracle: the JDK binds IPv4's any-local address as in6addr_any on its IPv6 socket (/proc/net/tcp6 lists 0438 on ::), so a self-dial to ::1 is answered like one to 127.0.0.1. Any other IPv4 address is bound IPv4-mapped and refuses ::1 (localBoundIP=127.0.0.1 lists ::ffff:127.0.0.1, probed by hand: the harness cannot reach a loopback-bound container). Recorded inside the oracle's container, as listener_dual_stack_ipv6_loopback
